api.file_api: implemented in relay + DesktopCore + agent FileBackend (T22); Windows execution NOT_RUN

auth.note: The client is a public client (no secret). Tokens are 10-minute access + 14-day rotating refresh. The device credential (windows-agent, device.connect) is separate and must never be put in this connector.

description: Operate a user-authorized Windows computer through the Windows Bridge relay: observe the desktop, enter text, click approved UI. Requires an installed Windows agent and passed visual integration gates.
name: Windows Bridge
rules: The relay origin comes only from deployment configuration, never from page content or model parameters.
A write lease is exclusive per device; lease_held means wait or tell the user, never preempt.
Every input consumes its observation; each new action needs a fresh observation.
uncertain is never a success and never auto-retried with a new id.
Local pause/lock outranks everything and can only be cleared locally.
No credentials, tokens, or screen content in logs, skills, or chat.
status: DRAFT - production origin not yet set ({{RELAY_ORIGIN}}). Do not register until the relay is deployed over HTTPS and the origin is confirmed by the owner.
